cohort: 281 women who experienced term prelabor rupture of membranes (PROM), had singleton fetuses in the vertex position, and received midwifery care at a large Midwest hospital between January 2016 and December 2018.
finding: Expectant management of term PROM, either at home or in the hospital, did not lead to significant differences in maternal or neonatal outcomes compared to immediate induction of labor.
